purpose: Trigger-boundary regression set for ugt-nextjs-pitfalls. S* symptom queries must route to ugt-nextjs-pitfalls; N* queries must NOT (their expected target is informational). Rerun by giving a fresh model the plugin skill listing plus each query independently and asking which skill it would invoke/read first.
method: 3 independent judges, randomized order, full skill listing incl. superpowers distractors

baseline_result.note: iteration 0 scored 54/60 (S-side 24/30, N-side 30/30): all 3 judges routed S9 (wrong row selected) and S10 (stale code after edit) to superpowers:systematic-debugging because those two symptoms were missing from the description. Description updated to include both; iteration 1 re-ran 3 fresh judges → 60/60. Optimizer loop terminated at iteration 1.
